rows.head: Barron returns to Nashville
rows.story: The Predators are winless in three (0-1-2). The Blues are 3-3-1. It’s strength against strength: the Blues are the league’s best for chance quality, but the Predators are near the top at preventing dangerous shots.

rows.head: Who’s in net for the Rangers?
rows.story: The Rangers come in at 6-3-0, the Blue Jackets at 2-3-0. It’s strength against strength: the Blue Jackets are one of the league’s best for chance quality, but the Rangers are one of the best at preventing dangerous shots. At home, Rick Bowness likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Rangers’ first line.

rows.head: Samoskevich returns to Florida
rows.story: The Panthers have won two in a row. The Kraken are 5-2-1. Don’t read much into Daccord’s record against the Panthers.

rows.head: The Maple Leafs’ power play has a target
rows.story: The Maple Leafs won the first meeting this season, 2-1 in Toronto. The Islanders come in at 3-3-1, the Leafs at 3-3-2. The Maple Leafs’ power play has a soft target in the Islanders’ kill.

rows.head: Korczak returns to Vegas
rows.story: The Golden Knights have won two in a row, the last a 6-2 rout of Calgary. The Penguins are 3-4-1. It’s strength against strength: the Penguins are one of the league’s best for chance quality, but the Golden Knights are one of the best at preventing dangerous shots.

rows.head: The Canucks need a win
rows.story: The Lightning are 5-2-0. The Canucks are winless in six (0-5-1). At home, Jon Cooper likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Canucks’ first line.

rows.head: Penalties could cost the Sharks
rows.story: The Sharks come in at 4-3-0, the Red Wings at 2-3-2. At home, Todd McLellan likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Sharks’ second line. The Red Wings’ power play has a soft target in the Sharks’ kill.

rows.head: Bedard’s favorite opponent
rows.story: The Blackhawks have won two in a row. The Stars are 3-3-1. At home, Jeff Blashill likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Stars’ first line.

rows.head: The Hurricanes come in hot
rows.story: The Jets are 4-1-2. The Hurricanes are on a tear, six straight wins. At home, Scott Arniel likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Hurricanes’ third line.

rows.head: Suzuki’s favorite opponent

rows.head: The Bruins come in hot
rows.story: The Kings are winless in five (0-3-2). The Bruins have won four straight. The Bruins have the edge over the Kings on shot quality.

rows.head: The Flyers need a win
rows.story: The Senators won the first meeting this season, 2-1 in Ottawa. The Flyers are winless in nine (0-6-3). The Sens are 6-2-0.

rows.head: McDavid’s favorite opponent
rows.story: The Mammoth won the first meeting this season, 4-2 in Edmonton. The Mammoth have won three straight. The Oilers are 5-1-1.

rows.head: Second night of a back-to-back for the Blue Jackets
rows.story: The Blue Jackets come in at 2-3-0, the Wild at 5-2-1. At home, John Hynes likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Blue Jackets’ first line. The Jackets played last night; the Wild are rested.

rows.head: The Hurricanes are rolling
rows.story: The Flames are 1-6-0. The Hurricanes are on a tear, six straight wins. It’s strength against strength: the Flames are one of the league’s best for shot volume, but the Hurricanes are the best at keeping shots away.

rows.head: Who’s in net for the Rangers?
rows.story: The Ducks come in at 4-3-0, the Rangers at 6-3-0. It’s strength against strength: the Rangers are near the top of the league for the power play, but the Ducks are near the top at the penalty kill. At home, Mike Sullivan likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Ducks’ first line.

rows.head: Juulsen returns to Philadelphia
rows.story: The Flyers are winless in nine (0-6-3). The Avalanche are 5-2-1. At home, Rick Tocchet likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Avalanche’s first line.

rows.note: Maple Leafs PP vs. Sharks PK
rows.head: Penalties could cost the Sharks
rows.story: The Sharks come in at 4-3-0, the Maple Leafs at 3-3-2. The Maple Leafs’ power play has a soft target in the Sharks’ kill. The Sharks hit a lot, but the Leafs mostly don’t.

rows.head: Forecheck against patience
rows.story: The Mammoth have won three straight. The Penguins are 3-4-1. The Mammoth hound the puck, but the Penguins sit back.
